notes.subject: fix(browser-gateway): forward managed-network evidence in owner interaction payloads
notes.summary: Browser gateway owner interaction payloads now forward managed-network approval evidence, and malformed evidence falls back to the reject-only card instead of dropping the interaction.

notes.subject: fix(webview): keep transcript following latest after scroll clamping and viewport resize
notes.summary: The chat transcript keeps following the latest content after scroll clamping or viewport resizing, no longer mistaking browser-driven scrollTop reductions for a user scrolling up.

notes.subject: feat(approvals): remember Guardian-approved sandbox sites per session
notes.summary: Guardian- or Jev-approved low/medium-risk public sandbox destinations are saved as exact session-scoped allow rules so later commands to the same site skip review, and tool guidance now steers web research to web_search/web_fetch over curl/wget.

notes.subject: fix(marketplace): use unique display name for Marketplace listing
notes.summary: The VS Code extension's Marketplace display name changes to "AgentLink: AI Coding Agent" so it can be listed; the extension ID is unchanged.

notes.subject: fix: let sandboxed Go CLIs verify TLS and stop web_fetch repeating short pages
notes.summary: Sandboxed Go CLIs such as gh can now verify TLS on macOS when the command has network access, and Codex web_fetch no longer repeats the same short page on continuation.

notes.subject: fix(cli): make condense work on Codex models and fix TUI focus and activity count
notes.summary: Condensing now works on Codex models, the CLI shows the underlying cause of failed turns, the activity count ignores the Context row, and Escape returns focus to the composer.
